cases.observed: 790×690 centered settings dialog, matching theme palette/rounding, persistent footer and readable Git form; actual git version 2.50.1 (Apple Git-155), CORE selected, local/local QA identity retained. Native image shows project selector, git executable, actual detected version, refresh/fetch and inline preference; repository identity/credentials/helper are below initial viewport and retained in same full AX.
acceptedDifferences: Real git-path/file-picker/detection controls, source labels and per-row resets, auto-fetch and fast-forward policy add truthful content and vertical scrolling; do not remove capabilities to match simplified static reference.
Actual grouped Appearance navigation has seven top-level sections rather than twelve illustrative sections; Git remains clearly selected, footer does not overlap content.
Only readonly detection was allowed once per layout after Settings section changes reset transient detection state; no configuration field changes during F07.
git.path and git.diffView are global-scoped fields even when CORE is selected. Effective inline does not prove raw-key presence; owner before/final receipts separately prove diffView absent.

sharedAcceptedDifferences: Actual QA workspace/project/file/commit values and counts are truthful data, not geometric failures.
Native traffic lights/configured shortcut/font rasterization/JPEG and capture cursor remain unedited.
Readonly baseline, paging, AI context, explicit remote inputs and safety controls remain real capabilities.
notes: Native and exact same-style reference originals personally viewed; complete AX hashed with detected version, project identity and current field sources.
Mist lower-scroll viewport differs from other seven upper-scroll viewports; no claim all settings or detected-version pixels are simultaneously visible.
Prior Paper undetected extra frame retained separately; it is not substituted for this detected final frame.
scope: Original-native versus exact same-style reference visual review only; no functional retest, source/GUI/fixture mutation.
